description: A diagnostic imaging coordinator must assign the hospital network's one available mobile vascular-ultrasound visit tomorrow among three facility patients and finalize the test, appointment time, authorization record, and alternative arrangements.

shared_context.S1: The network has one mobile vascular-ultrasound visit available tomorrow for patients at Cedar Grove, Harbor House, and Maple Ridge.
shared_context.S2: Leah makes the final assignment and records the resulting imaging plan.
shared_context.S3: Each facility has submitted a patient for diagnostic ultrasound, and all three requests are awaiting scheduling.
shared_context.S4: At the daily coordination huddle, the hospital's routine process is for the hospitalist, mobile sonography lead, utilization review specialist, and facility liaison each to submit a formal report aloud before Leah locks the route; Leah's closing checklist requires her to summarize each report and include every report's resulting action or arrangement in the final imaging plan.
shared_context.S5: Harbor House has no representative in this huddle; the four named roles are the complete reporting group, and Leah may lock the route after those four formal reports have been submitted and summarized.

PF1.text: The Cedar Grove patient has new unilateral leg swelling and requires a venous duplex before the anticoagulation decision can be made; Dr. Shah assessed the patient this morning, but the imaging indication has not yet been entered in the shared scheduling queue.

PF2.text: The mobile unit can perform Cedar Grove's venous duplex tomorrow only at 10:30 because that visit requires the portable vascular transducer and 45 minutes of setup; Marco has this equipment and route detail in the sonography dispatch log.

PF3.text: The Cedar Grove patient's study is authorized under code VD-219, with approval valid only for tomorrow; Nina received the payer confirmation this morning, but the authorization record has not been attached to the imaging request.

PF4.text: Maple Ridge has arranged a contracted vascular-ultrasound study for Monday at 09:00 and has confirmed wheelchair transport for that appointment, so the Maple Ridge request can be deferred if that exact alternative is recorded; Owen confirmed this with the facility's scheduler.

acceptance_conditions: The mobile visit must be assigned to the Cedar Grove patient.
The study must be documented as a venous duplex.
The appointment must be set for 10:30 tomorrow.
The authorization must be recorded as authorized or approved under code VD-219.
The Maple Ridge alternative must be recorded as the contracted Monday 09:00 study with wheelchair transport.
The clinical indication for Cedar Grove must be cited as justification for the assignment.

content_checks.C3: decisions['appointment_time'] == '10:30' or decisions['appointment_time'] == '10:30 tomorrow' or decisions['appointment_time'] == 'tomorrow at 10:30' or decisions['appointment_time'] == '10:30 AM' or decisions['appointment_time'] == '10:30 AM tomorrow' or decisions['appointment_time'] == 'tomorrow at 10:30 AM'
content_checks.C4: ('authorized' in decisions['authorization_status'] or 'approved' in decisions['authorization_status']) and decisions['authorization_code'] == 'VD-219'
content_checks.C5: any('Monday' in c['detail'] and '09:00' in c['detail'] and 'vascular-ultrasound' in c['detail'] and 'wheelchair' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in revealed
provenance_checks.P3: 'PF4' in credited_facts and 'PF4' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF4' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The new unilateral swelling and required venous duplex change the selected patient from an unresolved facility request to Cedar Grove and provide the specific clinical justification.
The portable vascular transducer requirement changes the study documentation to venous duplex and fixes Cedar Grove's feasible appointment time at exactly 10:30.
The payer confirmation changes the authorization fields to an approved or authorized status with the exact code VD-219.
The confirmed facility arrangement changes Maple Ridge's alternative from an unspecified future arrangement to a vascular-ultrasound study on Monday at exactly 09:00 with wheelchair transport.
